files.title: De Occulta Philosophia (Three Books of Occult Philosophy)
files.author: Heinrich Cornelius Agrippa
files.source: Library of Congress Rare Book Collection (rbc0001.2009gen12345)
files.notes: FOUNDATIONAL Renaissance occult text. Covers natural magic, celestial magic, and ceremonial/religious magic. Contains the Theban alphabet. One of the most important esoteric texts in Western history. Image-only scan (no OCR text layer). Perfect for the alchemical staircase.

files.title: The Bakerian Lecture: on the theory of light and colours
files.author: Thomas Young (1773-1829)
files.source: Yale Medical Library Historical Library (Fulton Collection)
files.notes: One of the most important physics papers in history. Young's wave theory of light and the principle of interference. Foundation of modern optics.
